subject: Custom rateband request for high-volume hosted API — Nebula AI
messages:
From: Simon Leung <simon.leung@nebulaai.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T10:13:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing inquiry — high volume

Hi Camila,

Quick intro — I'm Simon on the platform team at Nebula AI. We're evaluating Redwood for our inference layer and expect large steady usage starting Q3. Ballpark: 4–6 billion tokens / month for the first 12 months, with burst months higher.

Can you share your standard per-token rate card and any volume / commit discounts? Procurement will need a committed pricing option (monthly or annual commit) and an estimate of unit cost at ~5B tokens/mo. Also interested in minimum SLAs and any restrictions on caching/retention for hosted API.

I've attached a short forecast for context (nebula-q2-forecast.xlsx). Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Simon Leung
Infrastructure Lead, Nebula AI
---
Attachment: nebula-q2-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Simon Leung <simon.leung@nebulaai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — high volume

Hi Simon — thanks for the details and the forecast. I can put together a commit-based proposal and a few tiered rate examples.

High-level (for discussion):
- List per-token (hosted): $0.00060 / token (baseline)
- Suggested commit tiers: $80k/mo -> $0.00048/token; $120k/mo -> $0.00036/token; $200k+/mo -> custom negotiated band

I want to run a quick internal check on how deep we can go on a custom rateband for a 12-month commit. Looping in Karthik (sales lead) and Laura (finance) to confirm margin and approval path. Marissa, FYI — this one may need an exception if Nebula expects >25% off list.

I'll draft a proposal PDF and come back with a recommended structure.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: pricing-proposal-draft.pdf (internal draft)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API pricing inquiry — high volume

Camila — thanks. Competitive context: Nebula is evaluating two vendors. They sign quickly with predictable economics. They asked us offline about a 40% off list ask for 12-months — that's aggressive. I recommend we offer a tiered "rateband" tied to committed monthly spend:

Proposal (sales recommendation):
- Commit $80k/mo (12mo): $0.00048/token (~20% off list)
- Commit $120k/mo (12mo): $0.00036/token (~40% off list) -> conditional on finance sign-off and legal approval of early-termination terms
- Commit $200k+/mo: require executive approval, potential revenue share/usage floors

Notes:
- Do not give uncapped per-token discounts without an absolute minimum monthly guarantee.
- Keep a fallback to list rates with auto-reversion if usage drops below 70% of forecast for two consecutive months.

Laura — can you validate that the $0.00036/token at $120k/mo preserves our SLO margins? If finance flags risk, let's aim for a middle ground (around $0.00040/token).

Karthik
Director, Enterprise Sales

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API pricing inquiry — high volume (cost check)

Team — ran a quick cost/margin model (see attached cost-model.csv). Key outputs:
- Baseline cost (infra + amortized infra ops) at Nebula profile: ~$0.00021 / token
- $0.00036/token -> gross margin ~40% before alloc; acceptable but tight if bursts exceed forecast
- $0.00040/token -> gross margin ~46% (safer)

Finance sign-off boundary: discounts that push us below ~42% gross margin require VP approval. That puts $0.00036 below the default threshold if we assume burst risk; $0.00040 is within acceptable range.

Conditional approvals:
- Approve up to 22% off list (approx $0.000468/token) without escalation for standard 12mo commit and usage floors.
- Anything deeper (>$120k/mo at 36% off) requires Marissa's explicit approval and legal protective terms (MTU/early-termination fee).

Attachment: cost-model.csv (spreadsheet)

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: Nebula custom rateband (conditions)

Thanks for the analysis. I approve a custom rateband for Nebula with the following commercial guardrails:

- Approved discount: up to 22% off list for a 12-month committed spend of $120k/month (minimum term 12 months).
- If we are asked to move to the $0.00036/token band at $120k/mo (~40% off list), approval requires an executive-level exception and additional protective clauses (early-termination fee equal to 3 months' commit, minimum usage floor 70%).
- Require a HubSpot deal line noting "custom rateband — finance approved up to 22%" and attach the cost-model.csv.
- Legal (Vivek) to confirm standard termination language; commercial to prepare DocuSign with those clauses.

Camila — please proceed to present the 22% band as the primary offer and hold any deeper discount conversations until legal & I sign off on the alternative. Update deal HUB-45321 accordingly.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations

From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Simon Leung <simon.leung@nebulaai.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nebulaai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Commercial proposal and next steps — Redwood + Nebula (HUB-45321)

Hi Simon / procurement team — thanks for the patience.

We can offer a committed 12-month plan at the following commercial terms (primary offer):
- Commit: $120,000 / month (12 months)
- Rate: $0.000468 / token (22% off list)
- Usage floor: 70% of monthly forecast; reversion to list rates if floor not met for two consecutive months
- Early termination: TBD (standard protective clause; 3 months' commit if alternative deeper discount is applied)

If Nebula wants to push to a deeper band, note this requires an executive exception and additional protective terms (per internal approval).

Next steps:
1) I will send a DocuSign envelope with the commercial SOW and the commit schedule (link below). Please review and sign: https://www.docusign.net/nebula/redwood-inference/ENVELOPE-8721
2) Once signed, finance will set up the billing schedule and we will provision the dedicated capacity routing for the hosted API.
3) Please confirm the HubSpot deal id (HUB-45321) and attach your PO if available.

Attachments: pricing-proposal-draft.pdf (updated for external), cost-model.csv (redacted)

Thanks — happy to hop on a call later today.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199
